author: Corridor Crew
description:
The upcoming Season 2 of Netflix's Devil May Cry, directed by our good friend Adi Shankar, will feature a sequence directly inspired by our short Tacticool. 

"It's not about the bullets you shoot, it's about how you get them in the gun in the first place." 

Thank you, Adi, and the whole team behind bringing these sequences to life in Devil May Cry.
title: Netflix Paying Homage to US?!
